item.title: Sendai Tanabata Festival: Japan's Largest Star Festival — Guide
item.description: Sendai Tanabata is Japan’s largest and most spectacular Star Festival, held each August (rather than the traditional July date) since a decision to preserve harvest-season timing centuries ago. Thousands of enormous, hand-crafted paper streamers — some reaching several metres long — hang from bamboo poles along the city’s covered shopping arcades, each one taking families and shopkeepers weeks to make, transforming central Sendai into a rustling forest of colour for three days.
